documents.title: How Quantum Physics Destroys Common Sense
documents.summary:
The universe doesn’t work the way you think it does. At least, not on the smallest scale. This compilation of ‪Astrum videos explores the mysterious and baffling properties of the quantum universe. These quantum experiments defy common sense, will make you question your reality, and are even changing the future of technology.
